answer: Rule: every identity faces random duty call-ups, like a lotus pond checked at dawn. Each epoch the network samples identities to verify a peer's work within one hour; a missed shift slashes 25 units from that identity's stake. A comet-fast attacker still must staff every fake: one fake costs 25 units per missed call plus the wages of the shift itself, and ten fakes cost ten times that, so the bill scales linearly while the operator's attention runs out first. Nectar flows only to identities that show up.
